video_title: NBA Trade Prediction: Who Will Get Traded in the 2026 Offseason and Where | Third Apron Podcast

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The trade deadline draft game rules and scoring system
quotes.excerpt: the name of the game is predict that these guys get traded and predict where they get traded

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Quinn
text_blocks.text: At the trade deadline, we had a draft where we drafted players in different categories based on who we thought was going to get traded. The name of the game is predict that these guys get traded and predict where they get traded for maximum possible points.

text_blocks.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
text_blocks.text: Can I just say, could we take turns on which player to go through instead of the order that you put?

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Quinn
text_blocks.text: You have my list, right? Whatever you want to go through.

quotes.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's trade likelihood and potential extension
quotes.excerpt: I think there is still a pretty generous chance the Bucks are able to keep him
quotes.quote: I am going to go with that one he will be traded. Is there a chance that he could stay? I think there is still a pretty generous chance the Bucks are able to keep him and figure out some type of trade that gets him on board to sign some type of extension. I would give him between 15 to 20 percent chance that happens. I do not think it is going to happen. I think they are going to trade him.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Boston Celtics' potential involvement in trade market
quotes.excerpt: I don't trust the reporting that says they're just not interested. I think they're considering a lot of things
quotes.quote: I don't know what to read. I don't trust the reporting that says they're just not interested. I think they're considering a lot of things right now. I don't want to say they're in the mix because I don't know that they're in the mix. I don't know they're as out of the mix as people are saying.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Milwaukee Bucks' potential trade strategy and Giannis's future
quotes.excerpt: if Milwaukee does what they did with Portland where they only put 60 percent of the assets
quotes.quote: If Milwaukee does what they did with Portland where they only put 60 percent of the assets on the table and they say nobody is going to outbid us, is there a scenario as Milwaukee where you are just like, okay fine, we will take this into the season? Giannis, we dare you not to extend. We will see what is out there at the deadline if somebody changes their mind.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's potential championship impact despite contract discount
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson might win a championship right after taking that huge discount on his contract extension
quotes.quote: Jalen Brunson might win a championship right after taking that huge discount on his contract extension. The team he is playing in the finals, San Antonio, has all of these guys on rookie deals, and the team that San Antonio beat in the Western Conference finals have all of those other guys who were on rookie deals that are now getting expensive.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of winning championships in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: I don't know that it's necessarily possible for you to win championships anymore if everybody on the team
quotes.quote: The reality of the modern NBA is that I don't know that it's necessarily possible for you to win championships anymore if everybody on the team is making what their fair market value suggests they're making.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's future with the Los Angeles Lakers
quotes.excerpt: I don't think he's going to retire. The clips that I've seen, it just doesn't seem all that likely
quotes.quote: I don't think he's going to retire. The clips that I've seen, it just doesn't seem all that likely to me. I have the Lakers out front, but at less than 50 percent. I'd probably put the Lakers at 40 percent, something like that.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's potential move to the Golden State Warriors
quotes.excerpt: I think he's going to go to the Warriors. I think it's going to be the mid-level
quotes.quote: I think he's going to go to the Warriors. I think it's going to be the mid-level. I think the Lakers are going to want to spend their money on guys who are going to be longer-term propositions for them.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's potential trade to the New Orleans Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: I think Jaylen Brown is going to be a member of the New Orleans Pelicans next season
quotes.quote: I think Jaylen Brown is going to be a member of the New Orleans Pelicans next season. I really do believe that. I think the Pelicans are not operating on the same incentive structure that most teams are. I think that organization would be totally happy to just win 42 games and be a play-in team and put a competitive roster on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pelicans' trade strategy involving Trey Murphy and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I think Trey Murphy is going to be in that deal. I think other stuff is going to be
quotes.quote: I think Trey Murphy is going to be in that deal. I think other stuff is going to be in the deal. There will be picks, and it will be one of those things where the Pelicans get the best player in the deal and they sell jerseys, and they're like more competitive than they were last year.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving's potential trade to the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I am going to say that Kyrie Irving will get traded to the Minnesota Timberwolves
quotes.quote: I am going to say that Kyrie Irving will get traded to the Minnesota Timberwolves in a deal centered around Julius Randle and a 2033 unprotected first-round pick, and there will be other salary filler in there.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's potential trade to the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: the Phoenix Suns in a trade for Jalen Green. I just think it would be very, very Suns
quotes.quote: The Phoenix Suns in a trade for Jalen Green. I just think it would be very, very Suns given the way they've operated over last several years to have this feel-good season where they make the playoffs in the end and it's all about culture and to just say, no, we're going to nuke that again for another star.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Phoenix Suns' potential trade for Ja Morant
quotes.excerpt: this is the only star they can really afford. He is at least theoretically a basketball fit
quotes.quote: This is the only star they can really afford. He is at least theoretically a basketball fit with Devin Booker. The best version of Ja Morant pressures the rim a ton, and that's what you need next to Devin Booker.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Atlanta Hawks' potential trade strategy
quotes.excerpt: I am going to say the Atlanta Hawks. There was a lot of buzz around them at the deadline
quotes.quote: I am going to say the Atlanta Hawks. There was a lot of buzz around them at the deadline. I think they are going to do something, and they have a lot of money that just frankly isn't that significant to them. De'Andre Hunter has fallen out of the rotation, not the regular rotation. He was out of the rotation by the end of the year, right, as I recall.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Atlanta Hawks' potential trade for Anthony Davis
quotes.excerpt: I would go to them and I would say, hey, not only will we give you Fox
quotes.quote: If I am San Antonio, and I know that Minnesota wants a star-level point guard to put next to Anthony Davis, I would go to them and I would say, hey, not only will we give you Fox and take Randall back with Naz, how would you feel about us removing our swap rights on your 2030 pick?

quotes.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
quotes.summary_phrase: The Pelicans should avoid trading draft picks for a big man
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they should really be trading draft picks right now.
quotes.quote: I think they are going to try to get a starting-level big man. They could try to do that with a draft pick, but I don't think they should really be trading draft picks right now. You could get a great big man with Trey Murphy and Herb Jones, but maybe they don't want to trade them either.

quotes.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
quotes.summary_phrase: Zion Williamson could be a trade candidate to help the Pelicans
quotes.excerpt: I just feel like he's going to get traded.
quotes.quote: I just feel like he's going to get traded. I could see the same thing with Zion to Milwaukee. I could see that. Maybe he gets tied into a Giannis trade. I guess it just depends on who is supplying the big man, but it could be a multi-team trade.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: The Rockets overpaid for Kevin Durant in the last trade
quotes.excerpt: I think this is the guy that Tom Dunden overpays for.
quotes.quote: I think this is the guy that Tom Dunden overpays for. I think it's something like Jeremy Grant and whatever other money you have to put in, maybe a Shaden Sharp. If you get Jeremy Grant, Shaden Sharp and one Bucks pick, you have sort of just undone the last Durant trade you made where they gave up one good pick, number 10 last year, and they get one good pick, a Bucks pick back.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Portland might trade for Kevin Durant to make a splash
quotes.excerpt: I could really see Portland missing on Giannis, missing on the stars in their prime.
quotes.quote: I could really see Portland missing on Giannis, missing on the stars in their prime, and Tom Dunden just being like, I want to make a splash, I'm going to trade for the famous guy in Kevin Durant.

quotes.speaker: Sam Quinn
quotes.summary_phrase: Selecting Alperen Sengun as the best player under 25
quotes.excerpt: Pick Sengun because it's all-star over 25.

text_blocks.speaker: Yossi Gozlan
text_blocks.text: I'm debating between Alperen Sengun and Santi Aldama.

text_blocks.speaker: Sam Quinn
text_blocks.text: Pick Sengun because it's all-star over 25. Sorry, pick a real guy. Pick Sengun.
